description: Cost per replica-sweep against replicas per GPU, for the production lattice Rd=18.30, L=5, 5245 active sites. Two independent measurements of the same curve.

measurements.name: stitched
measurements.note: Low half (B<=128) and high half (B>=150) come from different containers, joined by B=75 and B=100 measured in both, which agreed to 0.31% and 0.50%.

measurements.name: single_container
measurements.note: Every batch size on one physical GPU, to answer whether the sawtooth could be device-to-device variation. It cannot: every jump reproduces, including the one that crossed the seam.

offset_is_not_constant.note: The shorter cell of the single-container run inflates every value, but not uniformly: the ratio falls from 1.129 at B=10 to about 1.02 at large B. That is a fixed per-cell overhead amortised over ten times less work. Shape deviation after removing the median bias is +8.7% at B=10 and under 2% for B>=100, which is where every jump lies.
